title: TikTok for games, every post built by describing it to an ai
author: ConstantContext
selftext:
i've been building whip, and the simplest way to say what it is: TikTok for games. you open the app and scroll a feed, and instead of videos every post is a tiny game you can tap and play right there. a one-thumb reflex thing, a daily guessing game, a dumb little arcade score-chaser. you swipe to the next one the way you'd swipe past a clip.

the part that's relevant to this sub: every game in that feed is built by describing it in plain words to an ai, from your phone, no code or engine or laptop involved. you type what you want, it generates the playable thing, and you keep refining it by describing the change.

i'll be straight about where the ai workflow actually is. simple tight mechanics (reflex, timing, guess-the-thing, score-chasers) come out genuinely fun on the first or second pass. anything with deep state or real physics still takes a few rounds of me getting more specific, and it will happily over-read a vague instruction (i asked for "haptics on a perfect tap" once and it buzzed on every single tap until i corrected it). so the feed leans toward small sharp games, which honestly suits the swipe-through format anyway.

the games run inside the app, so it's one install and then everything in the feed is free and ad-free.   
  
iOS: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whip-feed-for-ai-creations/id6758931714](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whip-feed-for-ai-creations/id6758931714)  
Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=run.whip.app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=run.whip.app)
